thesis: Kinship and impersonal institutions solve different care and trust problems; digital networks could recombine them.
role: Complete chapter 18 and analyze 18A, continuing previous batch.

ideas.statement: Dense kinship can sustain care while restricting exit; modern autonomy needs replacement care infrastructure.
Digitally assisted functional kinship can coexist with urban geography.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Tsimane findings challenge universal Western personality taxonomies.
Church/kinship hypothesis links marriage rules with cultural psychology.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Church hypothesis has causal/confounding disputes; not definitive Western-mind explanation.
No universal winner between extended kinship and impersonal services.
Digitally assisted reproductive communities are conditional futures.
